manifest.result: Canonical frontmatter, body and capabilities as JSON.
manifest.failures: Broken installation: reinstall. No provider needed.
manifest.guidance: Reads packaged metadata only; no credentials, target, browser or FFmpeg required. Library: Showrun.manifest().

arguments.request: Library dict; CLI JSON filename. Required identity, target, starting_state, ordered steps, authority; optional context and capture.

validate.result: status=valid and effective public request, or invalid_request error.
validate.failures: Unknown fields, unsupported target/action authority, invalid geometry or limits. Correct input. No provider needed.
validate.guidance: Checks structure only; it does not check target readiness or execute UI actions. No credentials, browser or FFmpeg required. Library: Showrun().validate(request). Before recording, prepare the starting state and inspect the effective request.

arguments.request: Same dict/file as validate. For generic URL targets, navigation_only=false and authority.ui={actions:[click,fill,select,check,scroll,key],allowed_values:[...],target_effects:all_in_session} explicitly authorize target-session effects. Narrower backend limits must be enforced by the target. Generic field assertions check label plus value or checked state. Without ui, legacy navigation-only remains the default. Optional authority.stories_comment={story_id,revision_id,text} with navigation_only=false enables one exact UI comment on a fresh prepared managed fixture. Steps accept visible_text and/or assertions (control visibility, managed review_panel visibility, retained_comment). Comment grants require retained_comment evidence.
arguments.storage: Library constructor or CLI --storage: retained operation and artifact root.
arguments.model: Constructor dict {provider, model, credential_env?, response_tokens?, reasoning_effort?}. response_tokens: integer 512–4096, default 2048 per call. OpenAI reasoning_effort: low (default for reasoning models), medium or high; unsupported model parameters fail. CLI --provider, --model, --credential-env uses default inference controls. Explicit provider/model required. Direct provider.complete inside a restricted Agent session; no stock session.execute loop.

record.result: Retained receipt with status, per-step outcomes, usage, resources, cleanup, partial flag and optional verified media.
record.failures: Missing credentials/runtime/capture dependencies; target not ready; refused actions; limits; missing destination; failed hold/capture/cleanup. Exact retry never executes again. Correct prerequisites and deliberately use a new ID.
record.guidance: Requires Linux, Chromium, FFmpeg/ffprobe and a concrete provider/model with credentials in the process environment. Run prepare-runtime in this installation before capture. Library: Showrun(storage, model).record(request). Prepare authentication and demo data first. URL targets stay caller-owned; managed Stories fixtures must come from prepare-fixture. Supply request_id, target, starting_state, ordered steps and bounded authority. UI actions and DOM disclosure require explicit grants; target spending is separate. Exact retries return the retained outcome without execution; retakes require new IDs. Assertions already true can skip actions. Check changed state and inspect decoded footage, not just success status. Capture is continuous silent footage, not editing.

status.result: Retained receipt plus cancellation acknowledgment; crashed owner may be uncertain.
status.failures: not_found: correct store and identity. No model, target or browser calls.
status.guidance: Reads the selected store without contacting the target, model or browser. Library: Showrun(storage).status(request_id). Use the same storage as record. Poll until terminal after cancellation; uncertain owner state needs inspection, not automatic replay.

inspect.result: Receipt with newly inspected hash and decoded media metadata, or restricted notice.
inspect.failures: Missing/changed/invalid artifact or missing FFmpeg. Preserve earlier receipts; do not replay. No model calls.
inspect.guidance: Requires FFmpeg/ffprobe to decode retained media; no model, target or browser needed. Library: Showrun(storage).inspect(request_id). Use the recording store. Integrity checks do not establish that the demo is readable or semantically correct; review the actual footage.

cancel.result: cancellation_requested; not cleanup proof and not rollback.
cancel.failures: not_found: correct store and identity. For crashed owner, inspect resources manually. No model calls.
cancel.guidance: Requests cancellation of a running record in the same store. Library: Showrun(storage).cancel(request_id). It does not undo target effects or spending. Read status until terminal and check cleanup; never infer that acknowledgment means processes have exited.

arguments.presentation: Library dict or CLI JSON file: title, html, sources?, purpose?, audience?. Retained source fields are filtered to Stories' public import shape.
arguments.destination: Absolute fresh empty caller-owned directory; never an existing store or symlink.

prepare-fixture.result: status=prepared, supplied_sha256 and exact target including story_id, revision_id and fixture_sha256. Use this target unchanged for managed recording.
prepare-fixture.failures: fixture_invalid or stories_missing: preserve any partial import, select a new empty destination after correcting the supplied content or installation. No model, dashboard or live-store reads.
prepare-fixture.guidance: Requires an installed Stories 0.1.0 Python interpreter and an absent or empty destination with an existing parent. Library: Showrun.prepare_fixture(presentation, destination, python). Imports supplied title/HTML and supported source metadata through public Stories APIs, without launching a dashboard or model. Media and structured documents are outside this fixture path. Use the returned target unchanged; record later starts and stops its isolated dashboard. Existing stores and symlinks are refused.

prepare-runtime.result: Prepared local Agent snapshot keyed by interpreter, prefix, Python/Agent version and bundle identity; model_calls=0. Other installations do not replace this snapshot.
prepare-runtime.failures: Setup requires network/dependency access. Explicitly rerun setup after correcting it. No inference or target launch.
prepare-runtime.guidance: Explicit setup may fetch Agent modules and write a local runtime snapshot. It does not call a model, install Chromium or start a target. Library: Showrun.prepare_runtime(). Run in the same installed interpreter that will record; another environment’s preparation does not transfer.

arguments.storage: Library constructor or CLI --storage: one configured retained take root. Review metadata is stored separately under .showrun-review.
arguments.workspace: Explicit versioned review workspace ID; the default is default. Remote-facing service/CLI/MCP calls may also provide explicit --demo scope.
arguments.operations: state, list, demo, take, clip, select, rename, prepare-delete, delete, draft, note, notes, playback, appearance, begin-intent, ack-intent, reject-intent, mp4, zip or serve. Intent admission accepts --kind and --payload JSON; acknowledgment and rejection target an exact intent ID. Exports refuse to overwrite an existing destination.

review.result: Provider-free retained demos/takes/clips, exact selection state, receipt outcomes, notes, durable request/CAS mutation receipts or original-byte downloads.
review.failures: Missing or changed receipts/media, restricted/unfinalized clips, stale versions, active-work deletion, out-of-scope IDs, missing exact confirmation, incomplete/uncertain cleanup, revoked/expired transfers, actionable MCP resource errors or CSRF failure. Review never launches a target or calls a model.
review.guidance: Works on retained recordings, including on macOS; no model credentials, capture runtime or target launch needed. Library: Showrun(storage).review_store(), then ReviewStore operations. Use one explicit workspace and optional demo scope consistently. Read state/version before selection or edits; mutations use exact identities, expected versions and request IDs. Notes never start capture. Deletion requires prepare-delete confirmation; MP4/ZIP exports preserve original media and refuse overwrite. review serve starts a local authenticated dashboard with a one-use bootstrap URL; keep it private. Use showrun review -h for operation flags.
